full_judgment: 2. Facts in the background of which Writ Petition No.2099 of 1994 was filed, in short, are that the respondent herein was granted lease of fisheries known as Gutaura Haor Khal and Shoilajura Haor Khal for years 1389 to 1391 B.S at the yearly rental of Tk. 2,28,000/-, that on 6-8-1981 the respondent deposited the rent for the year 1389 B.S and the lease deed was executed but possession of the fishery could not be delivered because of the decree dated 13-1-1979 of the civil court obtained by 3R1 party, that respondent paid Tk.4,56,000/- towards the lease premium of the fisheries for the years 1390 B.S to 1391 B.S and thus the respondent in total made payment of Tk.6,84,000/- towards the rent for the fisheries, as mentioned herein above, for the period of 1389 B.S to 1391 B.S, that the respondent did not get possession of the fishery for any of the years, i.e. 1389 B.S to 1391 B.S, in spite of payment of the rent for the said years, that respondent made representation for the refund of the money which he earlier deposited towards rent for Gutaura floor Khal and Shoilajura Haor Khal and thereupon Shilshwar fishery of mouza Hasimnagar was leased to the respondent for the years 1400 B.S to 1402 B.S at a rental of T1k. 90,625/-for 1400 B.S and on 10% enhanced rate over Tk. 90,625/- for the remaining two years and the possession of the fishery was delivered to the respondent, that an amount of Tk. 2,28,000/- was adjusted out of Tk. 6,84,000/- which was deposited earlier by the respondent and thus remaining Tk.4.56.000/- was lying with the Ministry of Fisheries, that by the Memo No. SA/3-C/12/13/2639 dated 14-9-1994, Additional Deputy Commissioner (Rev.) directed the respondent to deposit the rent for the year 1401 B.S in respect of the Shailshwar Bill Jalmohal and thereupon Secretary of the respondent-Society wrote to the Additional Deputy Commissioner (Rev.) Sylhet stating the facts in details and requested for adjustment of the rent for 1401 B.S out of Tk.2,28,000/- lying with the Ministry of land, respondent No.3 as the said amount have been adjusted by the Ministry of Land against the fishery in question i.e against the Shailshwar Fishery and as such respondent was not required to deposit rent for 1401 B.S or 1402 B.S. In the background of the aforesaid facts the respondent filed the Writ Petition No.2099 of 1994 seeking the Rule Nisi upon the respondents (in the writ petition) to show cause as to why the Memo. No. SA/3-C/62194/2639 dated 14-9-1994 directing the respondent to deposit rent for the year 1401 B.S in respect of the Shailshwar Fishery should not be declared to have been passed without any lawful authority and is of no legal effect.
